description: Document the diagnostics surface and the invisible-skip fix in the spec, and document how a user reads diagnostics on their Windows build (the accessible-logs deliverable). No behavior change; depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 being implemented so the docs describe the actual shipped surface. Small feature - a single coherent docs update.
steps: UPDATE .kiro/specs/hybrid-orchestrator/architecture.md: in the Section 8.2 model-selector diagnostics area (where ProviderEnumerationError / AvailableModelsResult are described), document (a) the new provider_diagnostics command and its display-safe ProviderDiagnosticsReport shape (per-provider id/kind/baseUrl/instanceBuilt/modelCount/error), (b) the always-reachable Settings 'Diagnostics' section and the chat status line, and (c) the invisible-skip fix: a configured provider row with no built instance is now reported as a per-provider enumeration error instead of being silently skipped. Match the doc's existing prose style and cross-reference conventions. Keep it DISPLAY-SAFE (note baseUrl is shown, keys never are).

UPDATE .kiro/specs/hybrid-orchestrator/tasks.md: add a short entry under the appropriate phase (the provider-visibility/diagnostics lineage) recording this diagnostics-first change - the provider_diagnostics command, the Diagnostics settings section, the providers-store load-failure capture, and the builtins.rs invisible-skip fix. Follow the existing task-entry format in that file.

ADD a short 'Reading model-picker diagnostics' subsection to README.md (near the existing model-selector / Providers discussion, or a new short section): explain that if the picker shows 'No models available yet', the user should open Settings -> Diagnostics, click 'Run diagnostics', and copy the per-provider readout (id, kind, base URL, instance built yes/no, model count, error) plus the chat status line; that this is the precise information to include in a bug report; and note that on Windows the app's stderr/log output can also be viewed by launching the installed executable from a terminal (PowerShell/cmd) so backend log lines during the load path are visible. Keep it concise and match README tone. Do NOT use em dashes.

SELF-AUDIT: no code changed, so no clippy/tsc/vitest impact. Confirm markdown files are prettier-clean if prettier covers .md (check .prettierignore / the frontend prettier scope - the spec/README live at repo root and may be outside the frontend prettier run; if so, no prettier gate applies to them). Record in findings which files were edited.
acceptance_criteria: architecture.md documents the provider_diagnostics command + ProviderDiagnosticsReport shape, the Diagnostics settings section, the chat status line, and the invisible-skip-now-reported fix.
tasks.md has a new entry recording the diagnostics-first change.
README.md has a concise 'Reading model-picker diagnostics' subsection telling the user how to run and copy the diagnostics readout and how to view Windows stderr/logs.
No source code is modified by this feature; only .kiro/specs/*.md and README.md.
No em dashes are introduced in any edited doc.
verification: Offline: review the three edited markdown files render correctly and describe the actually-implemented surface from FEAT-001/FEAT-002; confirm no em dashes.
CI (deferred): the build/test gates are unaffected by docs; a prettier .md check (if any is configured for these paths) reports no diff.
findings:
Docs-only feature documenting the shipped diagnostics surface from FEAT-001 (backend) and FEAT-002 (frontend). No source code (.rs/.ts/.tsx) touched.

Files edited:
- .kiro/specs/hybrid-orchestrator/architecture.md: in Section 8.2 (Model selector), added two bullets after the 'Populated on launch, refreshed on change' bullet. (1) 'Self-reporting diagnostics' documents the store loadState/lastError capture of an IPC rejection, the copyable chat status line (data-testid model-load-status: loading… / loaded N models from M providers / failed: <error>), the display-safe provider_diagnostics command returning ProviderDiagnosticsReport { configuredCount, totalModelCount, providerCountWithModels, providers: [ProviderDiagnostic { id, kind, baseUrl, instanceBuilt, modelCount, error }] } (camelCase), and the always-reachable Settings Diagnostics section with Run diagnostics/Refresh. Includes the DISPLAY-SAFE note (baseUrl or 'default' shown, keys never) cross-referencing Section 9.1/9.2. (2) 'Invisible skip now reported (backend)' documents the builtins.rs None-branch now recording a ProviderEnumerationError instead of a silent continue, and list_available_models_inner building the registry per-row so one un-buildable row no longer aborts the whole enumeration.
- .kiro/specs/hybrid-orchestrator/tasks.md: added a new 'Phase 12: Model-picker self-reporting diagnostics' section following the existing Phase 10/11 format (Goal, Dependencies, Tasks P12.1-P12.3, Deliverable, Parallelization, Verification/acceptance). P12.1 = backend self-report + invisible-skip fix + provider_diagnostics command; P12.2 = store loadState/lastError capture + chat status line + TS types + IPC wrapper; P12.3 = always-reachable Diagnostics settings section. Placed after Phase 11's Future work block and before the Cross-cutting section.
- README.md: added a '### Reading model-picker diagnostics' subsection inside the 'User interface' section (right before the SVG logo paragraph). Explains that if the picker shows 'No models available yet ...', open Settings > Diagnostics, click Run diagnostics, and copy the per-provider readout (id, kind, base URL, instance built yes/no, model count, error) plus the chat status line into a bug report; notes the readout is display-safe (base URLs and counts only, never keys); and documents that on Windows the app's stderr/log output can be viewed by launching the installed executable from a terminal (PowerShell/cmd).

DISPLAY-SAFE audit: all three docs describe only id/kind/baseUrl/instanceBuilt/modelCount/error and counts; explicitly state keys/secrets are never shown.

EM-DASH audit: `git diff | grep '^+' | grep '—'` returns nothing (clean). A pre-existing em dash on tasks.md line 316 (P9.4) was NOT introduced by this feature and is out of scope for a docs-only diagnostics change, so it was left untouched.

PRETTIER scope: frontend/.prettierignore + .prettierrc.json are scoped to hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/ only; there is no repo-root prettier config, so the repo-root README.md and the .kiro/specs/*.md files are OUTSIDE the frontend prettier run and no prettier gate applies to them. No code changed, so no clippy/tsc/vitest impact (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: build/test gates deferred to CI and unaffected by docs).
